# Aroha Palms

> Aroha Palms is a family-run collection of private-pool villas and apartments in North Goa, India, operated by Akahata Hospitality Private Limited. Two locations: quiet Mandrem (3 villas and 4 apartments) and Pilerne village (Villa Majestic and Villa Grande, bookable together as Villa Imperial).

Contact (calls and WhatsApp): +91 98342 20573 · reserve@arohapalms.com
Check-in 3 PM, check-out 10 AM. Rates are per night plus taxes. Every villa has a private pool; the apartments have no pool access. Caretakers live on site, on hand 9 AM to 9 PM and on call at night; 24/7 security. There is no in-house chef; a cook can be arranged at a charge.

## Locations
- [Mandrem villas and apartments](https://arohapalms.com/mandrem/): Villa Magnifica, Villa Paradiso, Villa Serenity, Villa Caia, Villa Encanto, Villa Marisol (the full estate), and apartments Suite de Emerald, Suite de Regal, Suite de Prestige, Suite de Platinum (Onyx and Lumina are 2 BHK combinations)
- [Pilerne villas](https://arohapalms.com/pilerne/): Villa Majestic (sleeps 14), Villa Grande (sleeps 12), Villa Imperial (both villas, sleeps 26)
